aboutGame.title: What is Anime Adventures?
paragraphs: Anime Adventures is a Roblox tower-defense game where you summon anime-inspired units, place them along a track, and stop wave after wave of enemies from reaching the exit. Every unit arrives with a rarity band, an upgrade path, an ability set, and a cost curve, so your roster grows with every pull and every level.

Gems, gold, and summon items fuel that growth, and short-lived promo codes are the fastest free way to top them up. This wiki covers the full Anime Adventures loop: working codes, unit tier lists, team building, traits and evolutions, farming routes, and the game modes worth your time.

faq.title: Anime Adventures FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Anime Adventures.

items.question: What is Anime Adventures?
items.answer: Anime Adventures is a free-to-play Roblox tower-defense game. You summon anime-inspired units, place them along a track, and defend against wave after wave of enemies while collecting gems, gold, and summon items.

items.question: Are there working Anime Adventures codes?
items.answer: Anime Adventures codes are short-lived, case-sensitive promo strings. Redeem them in the lobby Settings or Codes panel, and remember that each code can only be claimed once per account, so check the Codes page for the current list.

items.question: What are the best Anime Adventures units for beginners?
items.answer: Start with one strong area-damage carry and one income unit, then add a support and a crowd-control unit. A well-built lower-rarity unit that fills a role usually beats a mismatched Mythic.

items.question: How does the Anime Adventures tier list work?
items.answer: Anime Adventures tier lists rank units from S to C by how much they carry a mode. S-tier units are meta-defining, A-tier units are excellent in their role, and the lower tiers are solid stepping stones or niche picks.

items.question: Do traits and evolutions change Anime Adventures units?
items.answer: Yes. Traits multiply a unit's stats such as damage, attack speed, range, and cooldown, while evolutions can transform a mid-tier unit into a top-tier one. Because rerolls are expensive, spend them on the carry you plan to keep.

items.question: Where should new Anime Adventures players farm first?
items.answer: Clear story stages first, then farm the fastest stage you can clear reliably for XP and upgrade materials. Save boosters for event windows, and stop when you hit your session goal rather than draining all your stamina.
